_about: Public-domain Nicholas Wiseman (1802-1865, first Archbishop of Westminster, cardinal) for the Word Hoard: 7 volumes from Internet Archive scans: the Twelve Lectures on Science and Revealed Religion (1836), the Moorfields Lectures on the Principal Doctrines (vol. II, 1836), the Essays on Various Subjects (3 vols, 1853) and the Recollections of the Last Four Popes (1858). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
